title: Ensure a replication-only user is created and used for streaming replication
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolreplication = true AND rolsuper = false;
rationale: Using a dedicated replication user instead of a superuser follows the principle of least privilege and reduces security risks.
remediation: Create a dedicated replication role with the REPLICATION attribute and avoid using superuser accounts for streaming replication.

title: Ensure logging of replication commands is configured
rationale: Logging replication commands provides visibility into replication activities and assists with auditing and troubleshooting.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_replication_commands = 'on';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure base backups are configured and functional
rationale: Regular validated base backups are essential for disaster recovery and point-in-time recovery.
remediation: Verify that scheduled base backups complete successfully and periodically perform restore tests to validate backup integrity.

title: Ensure WAL archiving is configured and functional
rationale: Write-Ahead Log (WAL) archiving enables point-in-time recovery and protects against data loss.
remediation: Enable archive_mode, configure archive_command, and verify that archived WAL files are being generated successfully.

title: Ensure streaming replication parameters are configured correctly
rationale: Replication settings should be reviewed to ensure they meet availability, performance, and recovery objectives.
remediation: Review parameters such as wal_level, max_wal_senders, max_replication_slots, hot_standby, and synchronous_commit according to your replication architecture.
